searchText: Hi all! The agenda for the Repricings Breakout Call #2 is updated: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1785 I pinged each EIP champion. If you cannot attend, please find another author to present your EIP. Also, if we are missing any EIP that has not yet presented, reach out to me I will add you Hi client devs. Please aim to do a mainnet release by EOD. Thank you. **ACDT <t:1762178400:R>** Agenda: <https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1786> Stream: <https://youtube.com/watch?v=Um_f9tR-e_Q> Zoom: <https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/88479308162?pwd=9XvtF4kjIfZ42rQrvySQLJPu9bLz7u.1> X Stream: https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1MnxnPrOdBEGO https://forkcast.org/calls/acdt/060 another reminder: EL teams are asked to have written glamsterdam scoping proposals by ACDE this thursday (CL teams by next thursday at ACDC) brief discussion at ACDT today about the overwhelming number of EIPs to analyze; suggestions were made, e.g. disqualify those that are under-specified to reduce the list to further review. alex originally suggested that even higher level themes would be helpful to move the discussion along (https://forkcast.org/calls/acde/223/#t=1479) if its helpful, the forkcast rank page is updated and available: https://forkcast.org/rank glamsterdam scoping proposals This rank list is crazy. Way too many choices. I got as far as S tier for FOCiL then gave up. 😆 Can we add filtering by EL/CL? Most these eips are EL (40 out of 45).
